NEW SECTION . 280.36 Multidisciplinary school safety 7 assessment teams —— immunity. 8 1. The board of directors of each school district and the 9 authorities in charge of each accredited nonpublic school may 10 establish a multidisciplinary school safety assessment team. 11 If established, the multidisciplinary school safety assessment 12 team shall coordinate resources and assess and intervene when a 13 student enrolled in the school district or accredited nonpublic 14 school exhibits behavior that may pose a threat to the safety 15 of the school district or accredited nonpublic school, 16 employees of the school district or accredited nonpublic 17 school, or other student enrolled in the school district or 18 accredited nonpublic school. 19 2. The multidisciplinary school safety assessment team may 20 consist of any of the following members: 21 a. A local law enforcement official. 22 b. A representative from juvenile court services. 23 c. A mental health professional. 24 d. A social services representative. 25 e. A school official. 26 3. The board of directors of a school district or the 27 authorities in charge of an accredited nonpublic school 28 may enter into an agreement with another school district, 29 accredited nonpublic school, charter school, or innovation zone 30 school to create a multidisciplinary school safety assessment 31 team that shall coordinate resources among the schools and 32 assess and intervene when a student enrolled in either school 33 exhibits behavior that may pose a threat to the safety of 34 either school, employees of either school, or students enrolled 35 -3- HF 163.1656 (1) 91 (amending this HF 163 to CONFORM to SF 583) jda/jh 3/ 5 in either school. 1 4. In addition to any other immunity available, any person 7 who, in good faith with reasonable cause and without malice, 8 acts to report, investigate, or cause any investigation to 9 be made into the activities of a student or other person as 10 such report or investigation relates to conduct or information 11 indicating that the student or person poses a credible danger 12 of serious bodily injury or death to one or more students, 13 school employees, or others on school property shall be immune 14 from all criminal and civil liability that might otherwise 15 be incurred or imposed as the result of the making of such a 16 report, investigation, or disclosure. 17 6.
